title: pnpm-workspace supply-chain policy
description: Asserts the @callumhoward/config-base supply-chain baseline. Other keys (packages, allowBuilds, catalogs, …) are unconstrained.

minimumReleaseAge.description: Minutes a version must have been published before pnpm will install it. Baseline: 10080 (7 days).

trustPolicy.description: Block versions whose trust attestation is weaker than a prior release.
